records.name: extrude 100 boxes
records.notes: 148,753 boxes/s; volume exact against analytic 50,000 mm3. Harness: crates/cad-kernel-truck/examples/bench.rs.

records.name: boolean union (coplanar worst case)
records.notes: 20 pairwise unions per iteration, 100 results. 100 of 100 needed the coplanar retry nudge.

records.name: boolean union volume error
records.notes: Against analytic 1120 mm3 (0.0003%). Run-to-run volume spread 0.0 mm3.

records.name: tessellate a box
records.notes: 12 triangles at every chord tolerance, exact volume. Planar faces only; curved tessellation was not measured.

records.name: 200 solids held live
records.notes: Handle test: 200 created, 0 live after release(). Says nothing about a large assembly.

records.name: full workspace scan (15 repositories)
records.metric: wall time, median of 3 warm runs
records.host: i3-1125G4, debug build, warm page cache
records.notes: Runs were 2.63 s / 1.45 s / 1.45 s; peak RSS 23 MB. The first scan after a cold boot took 5.24 s because the page cache was empty. Includes 15 git status calls, 11 cargo metadata invocations and content hashing of ~8,400 files.

records.name: box build + STL write (process start to exit)
records.notes: Five runs were below /usr/bin/time's 10 ms resolution; 0.01 s is an upper bound, not a median.

records.name: geometry-ops agent call through the registry
records.host: i3-1125G4, 8 vCPU, 7.4 GB RAM, rustc 1.94.0, cargo 1.94.0
records.notes: Measured inside the integration test suite: a full geometry workflow (extrude, volume, tessellate) plus registry overhead completes in 1.35 s for the whole 12-test file, of which the kernel work dominates. No dedicated benchmark binary exists for the agent path yet; this figure is a whole-suite observation, not a percentile measurement, and is recorded as such.

records.name: analytic boolean correctness corpus
records.host: i3-1125G4, 8 vCPU, 7.4 GB RAM, rustc 1.94.0, cargo 1.94.0
records.notes: 10 fixtures against the truck adapter, including the three unsupported difference cases. The gate is the exit code: 0 while no must-pass fixture regresses.

records.name: studio start to first healthy /api/health
records.host: i3-1125G4, debug build, loopback, Fedora 43, rustc 1.94.0
records.notes: Median of five launches (7, 7, 10, 14, 16 ms), 1 ms poll interval. Includes project load, validation, one kernel evaluation and the bind. Replaces an earlier 1.14 s reading that was dominated by the poll interval, not startup.

records.name: GET /api/state
records.host: i3-1125G4, debug build, loopback, Fedora 43, rustc 1.94.0
records.notes: Median of 300 requests (p95 4.29 ms, max 27 ms), Python http.client, one new loopback connection per request. 2,278-byte JSON for a 28-triangle octagonal prism. The same client measured 10.22 ms before the accept loop stopped polling with a 10 ms sleep: 3.8x lower.

records.notes: Median of 30 requests (p95 5.53 ms), alternating depth 10/11 mm, one kernel extrude and tessellation per request, 2,278-byte response. Python http.client, new connection each time.
